rule: Begin at the midpoint of the prior middle-gap bounds
paper_evidence: Paper page 3, first specimen at midpoint
plain_language_effect: The first article is not biased toward either end of the starting range.

rule: Move toward smaller gaps after only no-interaction results
paper_evidence: Paper page 3 direction reversed explicitly for the decreasing-gap application
plain_language_effect: The tool moves toward the likely interaction region after misses.

rule: Move toward larger gaps after only interaction results
paper_evidence: Paper page 3 direction reversed explicitly for the decreasing-gap application
plain_language_effect: The tool moves away from the likely interaction region after interactions.

rule: Use binary search while the separated bracket is wider than one guessed variation
paper_evidence: Paper page 3, binary search until Diff is less than SigmaG; Figure 2 tests Diff > SigmaG
plain_language_effect: The tool closes a large empty gap efficiently before probing beyond it.

rule: Use D-optimal searching once the bracket reaches one guessed variation
paper_evidence: Paper Figure 2 and page 4 surrogate estimates
plain_language_effect: The former 1.5-times rule is not present.

rule: Multiply the working variation by 0.8 after every still-separated D-optimal test
paper_evidence: Paper page 4, SigmaG multiplied by 0.8 for each specimen
plain_language_effect: Repeated separated results keep pushing the search toward overlap.

rule: Do not fit the curve until interaction and no-interaction results strictly overlap
paper_evidence: Paper page 4, unique estimates begin after success/failure overlap
plain_language_effect: The tool does not pretend a stable bell curve exists too early.

rule: After overlap, limit an early fitted middle to tested gaps and variation to the tested range
paper_evidence: Paper page 4, fitted mean and variation restrictions
plain_language_effect: An unstable early fit cannot make the next request explode without limit.

rule: Choose the next fitted-stage gap by maximizing the information determinant
paper_evidence: Paper pages 2-4, maximize determinant of the information matrix
plain_language_effect: Later articles are placed where they add the most joint information.
